title: Earl K. Miller and coauthors — complete preserved research catalog
scope: All 1,072 preserved historical comparison-record IDs; metadata-only inventory, not 1,072 released evidence bodies or a complete-program scientific certificate.
metadata_status: Historical bibliographic fields and strength labels are preserved as recorded. Separately keyed primary metadata corrections are shown without replacing those fields or changing recorded author-edge totals.
evidence_status_disclaimer: Eleven records are linked to a selected-source review that is pending release approval. The other 1,061 evidence bodies are not yet released. Those records remain visible and open; this catalog does not mark them absent, rejected, or scientifically certified.
count_units: Records, distinct target document/version keys and recorded author associations are separate counts. Author associations are navigation edges, not additional findings or accusations.
